### Day 82: 1 Chronicles 22:11–19
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-82-1-chronicles-22-1119.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 22:11-19
Points:
- David used the final season of his life to equip Solomon and gather every resource needed for the temple.
- David's charge to begin the work reminds believers that God reliably supplies all that is necessary to accomplish His will.
- Instead of hesitating or complaining, Christians are called to actively get busy with the tasks God assigns.
- David’s call to devote heart and soul means firmly fastening one's inner life to seeking the Lord.

### The Temple Builder
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/temple-builder
Passage: 1 Chronicles 22:2-19
Points:
- David prepared materials, workers, and instructions for Solomon to ensure the temple would be successfully built.
- David was prevented from building the temple not because his wars were sinful, but because the builder had to be a man of rest.
- The peace of Solomon's reign typifies the final consummation of God's kingdom when all conflict ends.
- Believers anticipate that coming peace by living harmoniously with others and devoting themselves to true worship.
